review.tagline: Local inference server for LLM, speech and image models on AMD NPU and GPU
review.summary: Lemonade is a C++ local server that exposes OpenAI, Anthropic and Ollama-compatible APIs on http://localhost:13305/v1. It runs text, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, image and audio generation through several backends (llama.cpp, FastFlowLM, Ryzen AI, whisper.cpp, sd.cpp, vLLM) across CPU, GPU and XDNA2 NPU. It also ships a CLI, a Model Manager and an embeddable binary for bundling into other apps.
review.audience: Self-hosters and developers running local models, especially on AMD hardware
strengths: Supports NPU, ROCm, CUDA, Vulkan, Metal and CPU backends, selected per modality
Serves OpenAI, Anthropic and Ollama APIs, so existing clients connect unchanged
Covers chat, transcription, TTS, image and 3D generation in one server
Embeddable binary option with no installer, branding or telemetry
weaknesses: NPU backends are limited to AMD XDNA2; ryzenai-llm is Windows only
Many backends are marked experimental, including vllm, hrx, openmoss and trellis
Cloud offload to OpenAI-compatible providers is marked experimental
Backend support varies by OS and GPU, so check lemonade backends first
needs: Models: GGUF, ONNX, FLM, Whisper, Stable Diffusion
